summary: Add opt-in recovery for exact verified release drafts without retrying ambiguous creation

replay.detail: Release preparation does not change application replay.

schema.detail: No storage schema or data migration changes.

rules.detail: Application rules and exact-SHA product GO publication requirements are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The release candidate workflow accepts an optional recover_draft boolean, default false. It requires explicit tag, full source SHA and successful build run, sends at most one minimal draft creation request, and reconciles only an exact matching unpublished draft with digest-verified original assets. Ordinary ambiguous draft creation now preserves and reconciles committed drafts rather than deleting or retrying them.

downtime.detail: Release workflow changes require no service downtime.

manual.detail: To opt into draft recovery, select recover_draft=true with the original explicit tag, full source SHA and successful build run. Conflicting or incomplete evidence stops without deletion. Publication still requires separate exact-SHA product GO.

recovery.detail: Exact matching drafts can be adopted on repeated attempts, including partially uploaded candidates. Already uploaded assets must match their original SHA-256 digests; only missing original assets are uploaded. Ambiguous creation is never automatically retried or deleted, and recovery never creates a tag or publishes the draft.
